<file path="R/classes.R">
#' fmriproj Design Matrix Object
#'
#' A lightweight container for the trial-wise design matrix and
#' associated metadata used throughout the pipeline.
#'
#' @param X A sparse matrix (\code{Matrix::dgCMatrix}) or dense matrix
#'   containing the design matrix.
#' @param event_model An optional \code{fmrireg_event_model} object describing
#'   the experimental design.
#' @param hrf_info Optional list describing the HRF basis used.
#'
#' @return An object of class \code{fr_design_matrix}.
#' @export
fr_design_matrix <- function(X, event_model = NULL, hrf_info = list()) {
  if (!is.matrix(X) && !inherits(X, "dgCMatrix")) {
    stop("X must be a base matrix or Matrix::dgCMatrix")
  }
  if (!is.null(event_model) &&
      !is.list(event_model) &&
      !inherits(event_model, "fmrireg_event_model")) {
    stop("event_model must be a list or fmrireg_event_model")
  }
  if (!is.list(hrf_info)) {
    stop("hrf_info must be a list")
  }
  structure(
    list(X = X, event_model = event_model, hrf_info = hrf_info),
    class = "fr_design_matrix"
  )
}

#' Projector Components Object
#'
#' Container for matrices produced by \code{build_projector()} that are
#' reused across searchlights. Supports both legacy (explicit Qt) and new
#' (qr_obj) representations.
#'
#' @param qr_obj QR decomposition object from Matrix::qr (new approach).
#' @param R Upper triangular R matrix from QR.
#' @param RtR Optional precomputed \eqn{R^\top R} matrix.
#' @param lambda_global Ridge regularization parameter used.
#' @param Qt Transposed Q matrix from a thin QR decomposition (legacy).
#' @param K_global Optional global projector matrix (legacy).
#' @param tRQt Optional precomputed \eqn{R^\top Q^\top} matrix (legacy).
#'
#' @return An object of class \code{fr_projector}.
#' @export
fr_projector <- function(qr_obj = NULL, R = NULL, RtR = NULL, lambda_global = 0,
                        # Legacy arguments
                        Qt = NULL, K_global = NULL, tRQt = NULL) {
  
  # New, preferred path
  if (!is.null(qr_obj)) {
    # Validate new-style arguments
    if (!inherits(qr_obj, c("qr", "sparseQR"))) {
      stop("qr_obj must be a QR decomposition object")
    }
    if (is.null(R) || !is.matrix(R)) {
      stop("R must be provided as a matrix when using qr_obj")
    }
    if (!is.null(RtR) && !is.matrix(RtR)) {
      stop("RtR must be a matrix")
    }
    if (!is.numeric(lambda_global) || length(lambda_global) != 1 || lambda_global < 0) {
      stop("lambda_global must be a non-negative numeric scalar")
    }
    
    out <- structure(
      list(
        qr_obj = qr_obj,
        R = R,
        RtR = RtR,
        lambda_global = lambda_global,
        .internal_representation = "qr"
      ),
      class = "fr_projector"
    )
    
  } else if (!is.null(Qt)) {
    # Legacy path
    warning("The 'Qt', 'tRQt', 'K_global' arguments for fr_projector are deprecated. ",
            "Use 'qr_obj', 'R', 'RtR' instead.", call. = FALSE)
    
    if (!is.matrix(Qt)) {
      stop("Qt must be a matrix")
    }
    if (!is.matrix(R)) {
      stop("R must be a matrix")
    }
    stopifnot(nrow(Qt) == ncol(R))
    
    if (!is.null(K_global)) {
      if (!is.matrix(K_global)) {
        stop("K_global must be a matrix")
      }
      stopifnot(all(dim(K_global) == dim(Qt)))
    }
    if (!is.null(RtR)) {
      if (!is.matrix(RtR)) {
        stop("RtR must be a matrix")
      }
      if (!all(dim(RtR) == c(ncol(R), ncol(R)))) {
        stop("RtR must be square with dimension equal to ncol(R)")
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(tRQt)) {
      if (!is.matrix(tRQt)) {
        stop("tRQt must be a matrix")
      }
      if (!all(dim(tRQt) == dim(Qt))) {
        stop("tRQt must have same dimensions as Qt")
      }
    }
    
    out <- structure(
      list(Qt = Qt, R = R, K_global = K_global, RtR = RtR, tRQt = tRQt,
           lambda_global = lambda_global,
           .internal_representation = "explicit"),
      class = "fr_projector"
    )
    
  } else {
    stop("Invalid arguments for fr_projector constructor. ",
         "Either provide 'qr_obj' and 'R' (new style) or 'Qt' and 'R' (legacy).")
  }
  
  return(out)
}

#' Check for `fr_design_matrix` object
#'
#' Convenience function to test whether an object was created by
#' `fr_design_matrix`.
#'
#' @param x Object to test.
#'
#' @return `TRUE` if `x` inherits from `fr_design_matrix`.
#' @export
is.fr_design_matrix <- function(x) {
  inherits(x, "fr_design_matrix")
}

#' Check for `fr_projector` object
#'
#' Convenience function to test whether an object was created by
#' `fr_projector`.
#'
#' @param x Object to test.
#'
#' @return `TRUE` if `x` inherits from `fr_projector`.
#' @export
is.fr_projector <- function(x) {
  inherits(x, "fr_projector")
}

<file path="R/combine_projection_diagnostics.R">
#' Combine projection diagnostics from searchlight runs
#'
#' Simple helper intended for use as the `.combine` function in
#' `rMVPA::searchlight`. It collects the searchlight-specific diagnostic
#' information (currently `lambda_sl` and `w_sl`) from each call.
#'
#' @param x Accumulated results.
#' @param y New searchlight result to combine.
#'
#' @return A list with `results` (all searchlight outputs) and `diagnostics`,
#'   a list of per-searchlight diagnostic entries.
#' @export
combine_projection_diagnostics <- function(x, y) {
  diag_val <- cap_diagnostics(list(y$diag_data))
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(list(results = list(y),
                diagnostics = list(diag_val)))
  }

  x$results[[length(x$results) + 1]] <- y
  new_diag <- cap_diagnostics(list(y$diag_data))
  if (!is.null(new_diag)) {
    x$diagnostics[[length(x$diagnostics) + 1]] <- diag_val
  }

  x
}
</file>

<file path="R/explain_projection_results.R">
#' Create NIfTI map of searchlight diagnostics
#'
#' This function extracts the chosen searchlight ridge penalties (`lambda_sl`)
#' and optionally the collapse weights (`w_sl`) from the output of
#' `combine_projection_diagnostics` and returns simple NIfTI-like arrays for
#' visualisation. If the HRF basis matrix used during projection is provided,
#' an "effective HRF" (basis %*% mean(`w_sl`)) is also returned.
#'
#' @param sl_results Result object from `combine_projection_diagnostics` that
#'   contains a `diagnostics` list.
#' @param mask_dims Numeric vector giving the dimensions of the brain mask.
#' @param hrf_basis_matrix Optional HRF basis matrix used for computing an
#'   effective HRF from the average `w_sl`.
#'
#' @return A list with `lambda_map`, `w_maps` (or `NULL` if unavailable) and an
#'   optional `effective_hrf` vector. In a full implementation these would be
#'   `neuroim2` objects.
#' @export
explain_projection_results <- function(sl_results, mask_dims, hrf_basis_matrix = NULL) {
  if (is.null(sl_results$diagnostics)) {
    stop("No diagnostics found in searchlight results")
  }
  lambda_vec <- vapply(sl_results$diagnostics,
                       function(d) d$lambda_sl,
                       numeric(1))
  lambda_map <- array(lambda_vec, dim = mask_dims)

  w_list <- lapply(sl_results$diagnostics, function(d) d$w_sl)
  w_maps <- NULL
  effective_hrf <- NULL
  if (!any(vapply(w_list, is.null, logical(1)))) {
    K <- length(w_list[[1]])
    w_mat <- vapply(w_list, identity, numeric(K))
    w_maps <- vector("list", K)
    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      w_maps[[k]] <- array(w_mat[k, ], dim = mask_dims)
    }
    if (!is.null(hrf_basis_matrix)) {
      w_mean <- rowMeans(w_mat)
      stopifnot(ncol(hrf_basis_matrix) == length(w_mean))
      effective_hrf <- as.numeric(hrf_basis_matrix %*% w_mean)
    }
  }

  list(lambda_map = lambda_map, w_maps = w_maps, effective_hrf = effective_hrf)
}
</file>

<file path="R/model_factory.R">
#' Create rMVPA Model with Projection Support
#'
#' Main entry point for creating rMVPA models with transparent projection.
#' Uses S3 dispatch to handle different model types elegantly.
#'
#' @param model_spec A model specification object or list with class indicating type
#' @param projection Projection matrix or projection specification
#' @param ... Additional arguments passed to model constructors
#' @return An rMVPA model object with projection support
#' @export
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' # Create a classification model spec
#' spec <- model_spec(
#'   type = "classification",
#'   algorithm = "sda",
#'   data = my_data,
#'   labels = my_labels
#' )
#' 
#' # Create projected model
#' model <- create_projected_model(spec, projection_matrix)
#' }
create_projected_model <- function(model_spec, projection, ...) {
  UseMethod("create_projected_model")
}

#' Default method for create_projected_model
#' @export
create_projected_model.default <- function(model_spec, projection, ...) {
  # If model_spec is a list, try to determine type from contents
  if (is.list(model_spec) && !is.null(model_spec$type)) {
    class(model_spec) <- c(model_spec$type, class(model_spec))
    return(create_projected_model(model_spec, projection, ...))
  }
  
  stop("Don't know how to create projected model for object of class ", 
       paste(class(model_spec), collapse = ", "))
}

#' Create projected classification model
#' @export
create_projected_model.classification <- function(model_spec, projection, ...) {
  # Wrap data in ProjectedDataSource
  data_proxy <- create_projection_proxy(model_spec$data, projection, model_spec)
  
  # Build model with proxy
  build_rmvpa_model(
    type = "classification",
    algorithm = model_spec$algorithm,
    data = data_proxy,
    labels = model_spec$labels,
    ...
  )
}

#' Create projected regression model
#' @export
create_projected_model.regression <- function(model_spec, projection, ...) {
  data_proxy <- create_projection_proxy(model_spec$data, projection, model_spec)
  
  build_rmvpa_model(
    type = "regression",
    algorithm = model_spec$algorithm,
    data = data_proxy,
    response = model_spec$response,
    ...
  )
}

#' Create projected RSA model
#' @export
create_projected_model.rsa <- function(model_spec, projection, ...) {
  data_proxy <- create_projection_proxy(model_spec$data, projection, model_spec)
  
  build_rmvpa_model(
    type = "rsa",
    data = data_proxy,
    design = model_spec$design,
    distance_method = model_spec$distance_method %||% "correlation",
    ...
  )
}

#' Create projected feature RSA model
#' @export
create_projected_model.feature_rsa <- function(model_spec, projection, ...) {
  data_proxy <- create_projection_proxy(model_spec$data, projection, model_spec)
  
  build_rmvpa_model(
    type = "feature_rsa",
    data = data_proxy,
    features = model_spec$features,
    design = model_spec$design,
    ...
  )
}

#' Create projected vector RSA model
#' @export
create_projected_model.vector_rsa <- function(model_spec, projection, ...) {
  data_proxy <- create_projection_proxy(model_spec$data, projection, model_spec)
  
  build_rmvpa_model(
    type = "vector_rsa",
    data = data_proxy,
    contrasts = model_spec$contrasts,
    design = model_spec$design,
    ...
  )
}

#' Create projected contrast RSA model
#' @export  
create_projected_model.contrast_rsa <- function(model_spec, projection, ...) {
  data_proxy <- create_projection_proxy(model_spec$data, projection, model_spec)
  
  build_rmvpa_model(
    type = "contrast_rsa",
    data = data_proxy,
    contrasts = model_spec$contrasts,
    design = model_spec$design,
    ...
  )
}

#' Create projection proxy from data and projection
#'
#' Helper function to create appropriate ProjectedDataSource based on inputs
#'
#' @param data Original data
#' @param projection Projection matrix, function, or specification
#' @param model_spec Full model specification for metadata extraction
#' @return A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @keywords internal
create_projection_proxy <- function(data, projection, model_spec = NULL) {
  # Validate data
  if (!is.matrix(data) && !inherits(data, "Matrix")) {
    stop("Data must be a matrix or Matrix object")
  }
  
  # Validate projection compatibility
  if (is.matrix(projection)) {
    if (ncol(data) != nrow(projection)) {
      stop("Incompatible dimensions: data has ", ncol(data), 
           " columns but projection has ", nrow(projection), " rows")
    }
  }
  
  # Handle different projection types
  if (inherits(projection, "projection_spec")) {
    # fmriproj projection specification
    proj_fun <- function(Y) {
      result <- adaptive_ridge_projector(
        Y,
        projection$projector_components,
        lambda_adaptive_method = projection$lambda_adaptive_method,
        lambda_floor_global = projection$lambda_global
      )
      
      collapsed <- collapse_beta(
        result$Z_sl_raw,
        projection$N_trials,
        projection$K_hrf,
        method = projection$collapse_method
      )
      
      collapsed$A_sl
    }
    
    ProjectedDataSource$new(
      data = data,
      projection = proj_fun,
      metadata = list(
        feature_names = paste0("Proj", seq_len(projection$N_trials)),
        attributes = list(projection_spec = projection)
      )
    )
    
  } else if (is.matrix(projection)) {
    # Simple matrix projection
    ProjectedDataSource$new(
      data = data,
      projection = projection,
      metadata = extract_model_metadata(model_spec)
    )
    
  } else if (is.function(projection)) {
    # Function-based projection
    ProjectedDataSource$new(
      data = data,
      projection = projection,
      metadata = extract_model_metadata(model_spec)
    )
    
  } else {
    stop("projection must be a matrix, function, or projection_spec")
  }
}

#' Extract metadata from model specification
#' @keywords internal
extract_model_metadata <- function(model_spec) {
  if (is.null(model_spec)) return(NULL)
  
  list(
    feature_names = model_spec$feature_names,
    attributes = model_spec$attributes,
    design = model_spec$design
  )
}

#' Build rMVPA model using appropriate constructor
#'
#' Internal function that calls the actual rMVPA constructors
#'
#' @param type Model type
#' @param ... Arguments for the constructor
#' @return rMVPA model object
#' @keywords internal
build_rmvpa_model <- function(type, ...) {
  if (!requireNamespace("rMVPA", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("rMVPA package required. Install with: devtools::install_github('bbuchsbaum/rMVPA')")
  }
  
  args <- list(...)
  
  switch(type,
    classification = {
      algorithm <- args$algorithm %||% "sda_notune"
      do.call(rMVPA::mvpa_model, list(
        model = rMVPA::load_model(algorithm),
        dataset = args$data,
        design = create_mvpa_design(args$labels),
        ...
      ))
    },
    
    regression = {
      algorithm <- args$algorithm %||% "svr"
      do.call(rMVPA::mvpa_model, list(
        model = rMVPA::load_model(algorithm),
        dataset = args$data,
        design = create_mvpa_design(args$response),
        ...
      ))
    },
    
    rsa = {
      do.call(rMVPA::rsa_model, args)
    },
    
    feature_rsa = {
      do.call(rMVPA::feature_rsa_model, args)
    },
    
    vector_rsa = {
      do.call(rMVPA::vector_rsa_model, args)
    },
    
    contrast_rsa = {
      do.call(rMVPA::contrast_rsa_model, args)
    },
    
    stop("Unknown model type: ", type)
  )
}

#' Create MVPA design from labels or response
#' @keywords internal
create_mvpa_design <- function(y, blocks = NULL) {
  if (!requireNamespace("rMVPA", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(list(y_train = y, block_var = blocks))
  }
  
  rMVPA::mvpa_design(y_train = y, block_var = blocks)
}

#' Create model specification
#'
#' Helper function to create properly structured model specifications
#'
#' @param type Model type (classification, regression, rsa, etc.)
#' @param ... Model-specific parameters
#' @return A model specification object with appropriate class
#' @export
model_spec <- function(type = c("classification", "regression", "rsa", 
                               "feature_rsa", "vector_rsa", "contrast_rsa"),
                      ...) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  
  spec <- list(type = type, ...)
  class(spec) <- c(type, "model_spec", "list")
  spec
}
</file>

<file path="R/progressive_projection.R">
#' Progressive Projection Pursuit (fit)
#'
#' Fits a simple supervised dimensionality reduction model to the
#' searchlight trial patterns. Currently supports Linear Discriminant
#' Analysis ("LDA") and a rudimentary Partial Least Squares variant
#' ("PLS-DA").
#'
#' @param A_sl_train Matrix of size `N_train x V_sl` containing trial
#'   patterns.
#' @param labels_train Vector of class labels for each row of
#'   `A_sl_train`.
#' @param method Reduction method. Either "LDA" or "PLS-DA".
#' @param dims Number of projection dimensions to return.
#' @param tol Numeric tolerance added to the within-class scatter
#'   matrix when computing the projection for LDA. Increasing this
#'   value can help when the scatter matrix is nearly singular.
#' @return An object with elements `W` (projection matrix) and
#'   `method`.
#' @export
fit_pp <- function(A_sl_train, labels_train, method = "LDA", dims = 2,
                   tol = 1e-6) {
  if (!method %in% c("LDA", "PLS-DA")) {
    stop("method must be 'LDA' or 'PLS-DA'")
  }

  if (length(unique(labels_train)) < 2) {
    return(list(W = diag(ncol(A_sl_train)), method = method))
  }

  if (method == "LDA") {
    classes <- unique(labels_train)
    V <- ncol(A_sl_train)
    overall_mean <- colMeans(A_sl_train)
    S_W <- matrix(0, V, V)
    S_B <- matrix(0, V, V)
    for (cl in classes) {
      Xc <- A_sl_train[labels_train == cl, , drop = FALSE]
      m_c <- colMeans(Xc)
      S_W <- S_W + crossprod(scale(Xc, center = m_c, scale = FALSE))
      diff <- m_c - overall_mean
      S_B <- S_B + nrow(Xc) * tcrossprod(diff)
    }
    mat <- tryCatch(solve(S_W + diag(tol, V), S_B), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(mat)) {
      W <- diag(ncol(A_sl_train))
    } else {
      eig <- eigen(mat)
      idx <- order(Re(eig$values), decreasing = TRUE)
      W <- Re(eig$vectors[, idx[seq_len(min(dims, ncol(eig$vectors)))], drop = FALSE])
    }
  } else { # PLS-DA
    Y_ind <- model.matrix(~ labels_train - 1)
    cov_mat <- crossprod(A_sl_train, Y_ind)
    sv <- svd(cov_mat)
    W <- sv$u[, seq_len(min(dims, ncol(sv$u))), drop = FALSE]
  }
  list(W = W, method = method)
}

#' Apply progressive projection to new data
#'
#' @param pp_model Object returned by `fit_pp`.
#' @param A_sl_new New trial pattern matrix.
#' @return Matrix of projected data.
#' @export
predict_pp <- function(pp_model, A_sl_new) {
  if (is.null(pp_model$W) || !is.matrix(pp_model$W)) {
    stop("pp_model must contain a matrix component 'W'")
  }
  if (!is.numeric(A_sl_new)) {
    stop("A_sl_new must be numeric")
  }
  stopifnot(ncol(A_sl_new) == nrow(pp_model$W))
  (A_sl_new %*% pp_model$W)[, , drop = FALSE]
}
</file>

<file path="R/projected_data_source.R">
#' Projected Data Source R6 Class
#'
#' A proxy object that wraps original data and projection matrix, performing
#' projection on-the-fly when data is accessed. This provides transparent
#' integration with rMVPA models.
#'
#' @importFrom R6 R6Class
#' @keywords internal
ProjectedDataSource <- R6::R6Class("ProjectedDataSource",
  public = list(
    #' @field nrow Number of rows (observations)
    nrow = NULL,
    
    #' @field ncol Number of columns after projection
    ncol = NULL,
    
    #' @field dim Dimensions c(nrow, ncol)
    dim = NULL,
    
    #' @description Create a new ProjectedDataSource
    #' @param data Original data matrix or sparse matrix
    #' @param projection Projection matrix or function
    #' @param metadata Optional list of metadata to preserve
    initialize = function(data, projection, metadata = NULL) {
      # Validate inputs
      if (!is.matrix(data) && !inherits(data, "Matrix")) {
        stop("data must be a matrix or Matrix object")
      }
      
      if (is.matrix(projection)) {
        if (ncol(data) != nrow(projection)) {
          stop("data columns (", ncol(data), ") must match projection rows (", 
               nrow(projection), ")")
        }
      } else if (!is.function(projection)) {
        stop("projection must be a matrix or function")
      }
      
      private$.data <- data
      private$.projection <- projection
      private$.metadata <- metadata
      private$.cache <- NULL
      
      # Set dimensions
      self$nrow <- nrow(data)
      self$ncol <- if (is.matrix(projection)) {
        ncol(projection)
      } else {
        # For function projections, we need to test
        test_proj <- projection(data[1, , drop = FALSE])
        ncol(test_proj)
      }
      self$dim <- c(self$nrow, self$ncol)
      
      # Preserve row names, create column names
      private$.rownames <- rownames(data)
      private$.colnames <- if (!is.null(metadata$feature_names)) {
        metadata$feature_names
      } else {
        paste0("Proj", seq_len(self$ncol))
      }
    },
    
    #' @description Convert to matrix (triggers projection)
    #' @param cache Whether to cache the projected result
    as.matrix = function(cache = TRUE) {
      # Return cached result if available
      if (!is.null(private$.cache)) {
        return(private$.cache)
      }
      
      # Perform projection
      message("Projecting data (", self$nrow, " x ", ncol(private$.data), 
              ") to (", self$nrow, " x ", self$ncol, ")...")
      
      projected <- if (is.matrix(private$.projection)) {
        as.matrix(private$.data %*% private$.projection)
      } else {
        # Function-based projection
        private$.projection(private$.data)
      }
      
      # Add names
      rownames(projected) <- private$.rownames
      colnames(projected) <- private$.colnames
      
      # Preserve any custom attributes from metadata
      if (!is.null(private$.metadata$attributes)) {
        for (name in names(private$.metadata$attributes)) {
          attr(projected, name) <- private$.metadata$attributes[[name]]
        }
      }
      
      # Cache if requested
      if (cache) {
        private$.cache <- projected
      }
      
      projected
    },
    
    #' @description Get subset of rows (for chunked access)
    #' @param rows Row indices to extract
    get_rows = function(rows) {
      subset_data <- private$.data[rows, , drop = FALSE]
      
      if (is.matrix(private$.projection)) {
        result <- as.matrix(subset_data %*% private$.projection)
      } else {
        result <- private$.projection(subset_data)
      }
      
      rownames(result) <- private$.rownames[rows]
      colnames(result) <- private$.colnames
      result
    },
    
    #' @description Clear cached projection
    clear_cache = function() {
      private$.cache <- NULL
      invisible(self)
    },
    
    #' @description Check if data is cached
    is_cached = function() {
      !is.null(private$.cache)
    }
  ),
  
  private = list(
    .data = NULL,
    .projection = NULL,
    .metadata = NULL,
    .cache = NULL,
    .rownames = NULL,
    .colnames = NULL
  ),
  
  # Active bindings for property-like access
  active = list(
    #' @field data Access the projected data (triggers projection)
    data = function() {
      self$as.matrix()
    },
    
    #' @field original_data Access the original unprojected data
    original_data = function() {
      private$.data
    },
    
    #' @field projection_matrix Access the projection matrix/function
    projection_matrix = function() {
      private$.projection
    }
  )
)

#' Coerce ProjectedDataSource to matrix
#'
#' S3 method to allow seamless integration with functions expecting matrices
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @param ... Additional arguments (ignored)
#' @return The projected data as a matrix
#' @export
as.matrix.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x, ...) {
  x$as.matrix()
}

#' Subset ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' S3 method to support matrix-style subsetting
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @param i Row indices
#' @param j Column indices
#' @param drop Whether to drop dimensions
#' @return Subset of the projected data
#' @export
`[.ProjectedDataSource` <- function(x, i, j, drop = FALSE) {
  # Optimize row-only subsetting to avoid full projection
  if (missing(j) && !missing(i)) {
    # Use efficient row extraction
    return(x$get_rows(i))
  }
  
  # For column subsetting or both, we need full projection
  mat <- x$as.matrix()
  
  # Perform standard subsetting
  if (missing(i) && missing(j)) {
    mat
  } else if (missing(i)) {
    mat[, j, drop = drop]
  } else {
    mat[i, j, drop = drop]
  }
}

#' Dimensions of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return A vector c(nrow, ncol)
#' @export
dim.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  x$dim
}

#' Number of rows in ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return Number of rows
#' @export
nrow.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  x$nrow
}

#' Number of columns in ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return Number of columns
#' @export
ncol.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  x$ncol
}

#' Row names of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return Character vector of row names
#' @export
rownames.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  if (x$is_cached()) {
    rownames(x$as.matrix(cache = FALSE))
  } else {
    # Return stored rownames without triggering projection
    x$.__enclos_env__$private$.rownames
  }
}

#' Column names of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return Character vector of column names
#' @export
colnames.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  if (x$is_cached()) {
    colnames(x$as.matrix(cache = FALSE))
  } else {
    # Return stored colnames without triggering projection
    x$.__enclos_env__$private$.colnames
  }
}

#' Dimension names of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return List of row and column names
#' @export
dimnames.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  list(rownames(x), colnames(x))
}

#' Set row names of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @param value New row names
#' @return The modified object (invisibly)
#' @export
`rownames<-.ProjectedDataSource` <- function(x, value) {
  x$.__enclos_env__$private$.rownames <- value
  if (x$is_cached()) {
    rownames(x$.__enclos_env__$private$.cache) <- value
  }
  invisible(x)
}

#' Set column names of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @param value New column names
#' @return The modified object (invisibly)
#' @export
`colnames<-.ProjectedDataSource` <- function(x, value) {
  x$.__enclos_env__$private$.colnames <- value
  if (x$is_cached()) {
    colnames(x$.__enclos_env__$private$.cache) <- value
  }
  invisible(x)
}

#' Check if object is a matrix
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return TRUE (ProjectedDataSource behaves like a matrix)
#' @export
is.matrix.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  TRUE
}

#' Check if object is numeric
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return TRUE if the underlying data is numeric
#' @export
is.numeric.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  is.numeric(x$original_data)
}

#' Length of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return Total number of elements (nrow * ncol)
#' @export
length.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  x$nrow * x$ncol
}

#' Get class of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' For compatibility, returns class of the projected matrix
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return Character vector of classes
#' @export
class.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  c("matrix", "array")
}

#' Head of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @param n Number of rows to show
#' @param ... Additional arguments (ignored)
#' @return First n rows of the projected matrix
#' @export
head.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x, n = 6L, ...) {
  n <- min(n, x$nrow)
  x$get_rows(1:n)
}

#' Tail of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @param n Number of rows to show
#' @param ... Additional arguments (ignored)
#' @return Last n rows of the projected matrix
#' @export
tail.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x, n = 6L, ...) {
  n <- min(n, x$nrow)
  rows <- seq(x$nrow - n + 1, x$nrow)
  x$get_rows(rows)
}

#' Print ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @param ... Additional arguments passed to print
#' @export
print.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x, ...) {
  cat("ProjectedDataSource (", x$nrow, " x ", x$ncol, ")\n", sep = "")
  cat("Original dimensions: ", nrow(x$original_data), " x ", 
      ncol(x$original_data), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Projection type: ", 
      if (is.matrix(x$projection_matrix)) "matrix" else "function", "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Cache status: ", if (x$is_cached()) "cached" else "not cached", "\n", sep = "")
  
  # Show first few rows if small enough
  if (x$nrow <= 6 && x$ncol <= 6) {
    cat("\nData preview:\n")
    print(x$as.matrix(), ...)
  } else {
    cat("\nData preview (first 6 rows, 6 columns):\n")
    preview <- x$get_rows(1:min(6, x$nrow))[, 1:min(6, x$ncol), drop = FALSE]
    print(preview, ...)
    if (x$nrow > 6 || x$ncol > 6) {
      cat("[ ... ", x$nrow - 6, " more rows, ", x$ncol - 6, " more columns ]\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
  invisible(x)
}

#' Structure of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param object A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @param ... Additional arguments passed to str
#' @export
str.ProjectedDataSource <- function(object, ...) {
  cat("ProjectedDataSource [", object$nrow, " x ", object$ncol, "] ", sep = "")
  cat("(projected from ", nrow(object$original_data), " x ", 
      ncol(object$original_data), ")\n", sep = "")
  
  # Show structure of a small sample
  if (object$nrow > 0 && object$ncol > 0) {
    sample_rows <- min(2, object$nrow)
    sample_cols <- min(3, object$ncol)
    sample_data <- object$get_rows(1:sample_rows)[, 1:sample_cols, drop = FALSE]
    cat(" Preview: ")
    str(sample_data, give.attr = FALSE, ...)
  }
}

#' Transpose of ProjectedDataSource
#'
#' @param x A ProjectedDataSource object
#' @return The transposed projected matrix
#' @export
t.ProjectedDataSource <- function(x) {
  t(x$as.matrix())
}
</file>

<file path="tests/testthat/test-cached-optim.R">
test_that("make_cached_fn_gr caches results", {
  counter <- 0
  fn_gr <- function(w) {
    counter <<- counter + 1
    list(value = sum(w), grad = rep(1, length(w)))
  }
  cache <- fmriproj:::make_cached_fn_gr(fn_gr)
  w1 <- c(1, 2)
  v1 <- cache$fn(w1)
  g1 <- cache$gr(w1)
  expect_equal(counter, 1)
  expect_equal(v1, sum(w1))
  expect_equal(g1, rep(1, length(w1)))
  g1b <- cache$gr(w1)
  expect_equal(counter, 1)
  w2 <- c(2, 3)
  v2 <- cache$fn(w2)
  expect_equal(counter, 2)
  g2 <- cache$gr(w2)
  expect_equal(counter, 2)
  expect_equal(v2, sum(w2))
  expect_equal(g2, rep(1, length(w2)))
})
</file>

<file path="tests/testthat/test-combine-projection-diagnostics.R">
context("combine_projection_diagnostics")

test_that("diagnostics retained per result", {
  y1 <- list(A_sl = matrix(1), diag_data = list(lambda_sl = 0.1))
  out <- combine_projection_diagnostics(NULL, y1)
  y2 <- list(A_sl = matrix(2), diag_data = list(lambda_sl = 0.2))
  out <- combine_projection_diagnostics(out, y2)
  expect_equal(length(out$results), 2L)
  expect_equal(length(out$diagnostics), 2L)
  expect_equal(out$diagnostics[[1]]$lambda_sl, 0.1)
  expect_equal(out$diagnostics[[2]]$lambda_sl, 0.2)
})

test_that("NULL diagnostics preserve length", {
  old <- options(fmriproj.diagnostics_memory_limit = 0)
  on.exit(options(old), add = TRUE)
  y1 <- list(A_sl = matrix(1), diag_data = list(lambda_sl = 0.1))
  res <- combine_projection_diagnostics(NULL, y1)
  expect_equal(length(res$diagnostics), 1L)
  expect_null(res$diagnostics[[1]])
})

context("explain projection results")

test_that("explain_projection_results returns maps", {
  sl_res <- list(diagnostics = list(
    list(lambda_sl = 0.5, w_sl = c(1,0)),
    list(lambda_sl = 0.6, w_sl = c(0,1))
  ))
  basis <- matrix(c(1,0,
                    0,1), nrow = 2, byrow = FALSE)
  res <- explain_projection_results(sl_res, mask_dims = c(2), hrf_basis_matrix = basis)
  expect_equal(length(res$lambda_map), 2)
  expect_equal(length(res$w_maps[[1]]), 2)
  expect_equal(length(res$effective_hrf), nrow(basis))
})

test_that("explain_projection_results errors for basis/w_mean mismatch", {
  sl_res <- list(diagnostics = list(
    list(lambda_sl = 0.5, w_sl = c(1,0)),
    list(lambda_sl = 0.6, w_sl = c(0,1))
  ))
  bad_basis <- matrix(seq_len(9), nrow = 3)  # 3 columns, w_mean length is 2
  expect_error(
    explain_projection_results(sl_res, mask_dims = c(2), hrf_basis_matrix = bad_basis),
    "Number of columns in hrf_basis_matrix"
  )
})

<file path="tests/testthat/test-fr_projector.R">
context("fr_projector")

test_that("fr_projector validates matrix inputs for legacy format", {
  Qt <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
  R <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
  expect_error(suppressWarnings(fr_projector(Qt = 1, R = R)), "Qt must be a matrix")
  expect_error(suppressWarnings(fr_projector(Qt = Qt, R = 1)), "R must be a matrix")
})

test_that("fr_projector checks dimension compatibility for legacy format", {
  Qt <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
  R_bad <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  expect_error(suppressWarnings(fr_projector(Qt = Qt, R = R_bad)), "nrow\\(Qt\\) == ncol\\(R\\)")
})

test_that("fr_projector validates K_global dimensions for legacy format", {
  Qt <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
  R <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
  Kg_bad <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
  expect_error(suppressWarnings(fr_projector(Qt = Qt, R = R, K_global = Kg_bad)), 
               "K_global.*same dimensions as Qt")
  Kg_good <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
  proj <- suppressWarnings(fr_projector(Qt = Qt, R = R, K_global = Kg_good))
  expect_s3_class(proj, "fr_projector")
})

test_that("fr_projector accepts optional RtR and tRQt for legacy format", {
  Qt <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
  R <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
  RtR <- crossprod(R)
  tRQt <- t(R) %*% Qt
  proj <- suppressWarnings(fr_projector(Qt = Qt, R = R, RtR = RtR, tRQt = tRQt))
  expect_equal(proj$RtR, RtR)
  expect_equal(proj$tRQt, tRQt)
})

test_that("fr_projector works with new qr_obj format", {
  # Create a small test matrix
  X <- matrix(rnorm(12), 6, 2)
  qr_obj <- qr(X)
  R <- qr.R(qr_obj)
  RtR <- crossprod(R)
  
  # New format should work without warnings
  proj <- fr_projector(qr_obj = qr_obj, R = R, RtR = RtR, lambda_global = 0.1)
  expect_s3_class(proj, "fr_projector")
  expect_equal(proj$.internal_representation, "qr")
  expect_equal(proj$lambda_global, 0.1)
})

<file path="tests/testthat/test-integration-pipeline.R">
context("integration pipeline")

test_that("adaptive lambda and w optimization with theta optimization", {
  set.seed(1)
  Y <- matrix(rnorm(12), nrow = 6, ncol = 2)
  em <- list(onsets = c(0L,3L), n_time = 6L, basis_length = 2L)
  basis_fun <- function(theta, t) matrix(theta[1], nrow = length(t), ncol = 1)
  clf <- function(A, y) {
    pred <- A[,1]
    loss <- sum((pred - y)^2)
    grad <- matrix(2*(pred - y), nrow = length(y), ncol = ncol(A))
    list(loss=loss, grad=grad)
  }
  inner_fn <- function(A) sum(A)
  res <- optimize_hrf_mvpa(theta_init = c(1),
                           Y = Y,
                           event_model = em,
                           inner_cv_fn = inner_fn,
                           hrf_basis_func = basis_fun,
                           lambda_global = 0.1,
                           lambda_adaptive_method = "EB",
                           collapse_method = "optim",
                           labels_for_w_optim = c(1,0),
                           classifier_for_w_optim = clf,
                           optim_w_params = list(maxit = 5),
                           diagnostics = TRUE,
                           optim_method = "Nelder-Mead")
  expect_true(is.numeric(res$theta_hat))
  expect_true(!is.null(res$diagnostics$theta_trace))
})


test_that("diagnostic memory ceiling works", {
  old <- options(fmriproj.diagnostics_memory_limit = 1)
  on.exit(options(old), add = TRUE)
  em <- list(onsets=c(0L), n_time=2L)
  basis <- matrix(1, nrow=1, ncol=1)
  res <- build_design_matrix(em, hrf_basis_matrix = basis, diagnostics = TRUE)
  expect_null(attr(res, "diagnostics"))
})
</file>

<file path="tests/testthat/test-integration-rmvpa-models.R">
context("Integration tests - rMVPA models with projection")

skip_if_not_installed("rMVPA")
library(rMVPA)

# Setup test data
n_time <- 100
n_voxels <- 20
n_trials <- 30
set.seed(42)

# Create synthetic time-series with signal
Y <- matrix(rnorm(n_time * n_voxels), n_time, n_voxels)

# Create event model with two conditions
event_model <- list(
  onsets = seq(0, 90, length.out = n_trials),
  n_time = n_time,
  conditions = factor(rep(c("A", "B"), length.out = n_trials)),
  blocks = rep(1:5, each = n_trials/5)
)

# Add some signal to differentiate conditions
condition_effect <- as.numeric(event_model$conditions) - 1.5
for (i in seq_along(event_model$onsets)) {
  time_idx <- event_model$onsets[i]:(event_model$onsets[i] + 5)
  time_idx <- time_idx[time_idx <= n_time]
  Y[time_idx, 1:5] <- Y[time_idx, 1:5] + condition_effect[i]
}

# Project to trial patterns using fmriproj
trial_data <- project_trials(Y, event_model, verbose = FALSE)

# Create a simple projection matrix (PCA)
pca_result <- prcomp(trial_data, scale. = TRUE)
projection_matrix <- pca_result$rotation[, 1:10]


test_that("Integration: Classification model with ProjectedDataSource matches baseline", {
  skip_on_cran()
  
  # BASELINE: Direct classification with projected data
  projected_data_direct <- trial_data %*% projection_matrix
  
  dataset_direct <- mvpa_dataset(
    data = projected_data_direct,
    mask = array(TRUE, dim = c(1, 10, 1))
  )
  
  design_direct <- mvpa_design(
    y_train = event_model$conditions,
    block_var = event_model$blocks
  )
  
  model_direct <- mvpa_model(
    model = load_model("lda"),
    dataset = dataset_direct,
    design = design_direct
  )
  
  cv_scheme <- blocked_cross_validation(event_model$blocks)
  result_direct <- mvpa_crossval(model_direct, cv_scheme)
  
  # NEW ARCHITECTURE: Using ProjectedDataSource
  spec <- model_spec(
    type = "classification",
    data = trial_data,
    labels = event_model$conditions,
    algorithm = "lda"
  )
  
  # Create projected model (should use proxy internally)
  model_proxy <- create_projected_model(spec, projection_matrix)
  
  # Ensure the model is using our proxy
  expect_true(inherits(model_proxy$dataset, "ProjectedDataSource") ||
              inherits(model_proxy$dataset$data, "ProjectedDataSource"))
  
  # Run cross-validation
  result_proxy <- mvpa_crossval(model_proxy, cv_scheme)
  
  # Compare results - they should be identical
  expect_equal(
    result_proxy$performance$accuracy,
    result_direct$performance$accuracy,
    tolerance = 1e-10
  )
})


test_that("Integration: RSA model with ProjectedDataSource matches baseline", {
  skip_on_cran()
  
  # BASELINE: Direct RSA with projected data
  projected_data_direct <- trial_data %*% projection_matrix
  
  # Create distance matrix predictor
  condition_dist <- as.matrix(dist(as.numeric(event_model$conditions)))
  
  rsa_data <- list(
    brain = projected_data_direct,
    condition_dist = condition_dist[lower.tri(condition_dist)]
  )
  
  rsa_design <- rsa_design(
    ~ condition_dist,
    data = rsa_data,
    block_var = event_model$blocks
  )
  
  model_direct <- rsa_model(
    dataset = mvpa_dataset(projected_data_direct),
    design = rsa_design
  )
  
  # Train the model
  result_direct <- train_model(model_direct, projected_data_direct)
  
  # NEW ARCHITECTURE: Using ProjectedDataSource
  spec <- model_spec(
    type = "rsa",
    data = trial_data,
    distance_method = "correlation"
  )
  
  # Create with proxy
  model_proxy <- create_projected_model(spec, projection_matrix)
  
  # Need to manually set the RSA design for now
  model_proxy$design <- rsa_design
  
  # Get the projected data through the proxy
  proxy_data <- model_proxy$dataset
  if (inherits(proxy_data, "ProjectedDataSource")) {
    proj_data <- as.matrix(proxy_data)
  } else if (inherits(proxy_data$data, "ProjectedDataSource")) {
    proj_data <- as.matrix(proxy_data$data)
  } else {
    proj_data <- proxy_data
  }
  
  result_proxy <- train_model(model_proxy, proj_data)
  
  # Results should be very similar (allowing for small numerical differences)
  expect_equal(
    names(result_proxy),
    names(result_direct)
  )
})


test_that("Integration: Feature RSA with function-based projection", {
  skip_on_cran()
  
  # Create feature matrix
  feature_matrix <- matrix(rnorm(n_trials * 3), n_trials, 3)
  colnames(feature_matrix) <- c("F1", "F2", "F3")
  
  # Function-based projection
  proj_fun <- function(data) {
    # Simple dimensionality reduction
    svd_res <- svd(scale(data))
    data %*% svd_res$v[, 1:8]
  }
  
  # BASELINE: Apply projection manually
  projected_direct <- proj_fun(trial_data)
  
  # NEW ARCHITECTURE: Using function projection
  spec <- model_spec(
    type = "feature_rsa",
    data = trial_data,
    features = feature_matrix
  )
  
  model_proxy <- create_projected_model(spec, proj_fun)
  
  # Verify proxy is being used
  dataset <- model_proxy$dataset
  expect_true(
    inherits(dataset, "ProjectedDataSource") ||
    inherits(dataset$data, "ProjectedDataSource")
  )
})


test_that("Integration: Lazy evaluation and caching behavior", {
  # Track projection calls
  proj_count <- 0
  proj_fun_counting <- function(data) {
    proj_count <<- proj_count + 1
    data %*% projection_matrix
  }
  
  spec <- model_spec(
    type = "classification",
    data = trial_data,
    labels = event_model$conditions
  )
  
  # Create model with counting projection
  model <- create_projected_model(spec, proj_fun_counting)
  
  # Extract the proxy
  proxy <- if (inherits(model$dataset, "ProjectedDataSource")) {
    model$dataset
  } else {
    model$dataset$data
  }
  
  # Should not have projected yet
  expect_equal(proj_count, 0)
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # First access triggers projection
  data1 <- as.matrix(proxy)
  expect_equal(proj_count, 1)
  expect_true(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # Second access uses cache
  data2 <- as.matrix(proxy)
  expect_equal(proj_count, 1)  # No additional projection
  expect_identical(data1, data2)
  
  # Clear cache and access again
  proxy$clear_cache()
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())
  
  data3 <- as.matrix(proxy)
  expect_equal(proj_count, 2)  # Projected again
  expect_equal(data1, data3)
})


test_that("Integration: Memory management with clear_cache", {
  # Large dataset to test memory implications
  big_data <- matrix(rnorm(1000 * 100), 1000, 100)
  big_projection <- matrix(rnorm(100 * 20), 100, 20)
  
  spec <- model_spec(
    type = "classification",
    data = big_data,
    labels = rep(c("A", "B"), 500)
  )
  
  model <- create_projected_model(spec, big_projection)
  
  proxy <- if (inherits(model$dataset, "ProjectedDataSource")) {
    model$dataset
  } else {
    model$dataset$data
  }
  
  # Access data (creates cache)
  data <- as.matrix(proxy)
  expect_true(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # Clear cache to free memory
  proxy$clear_cache()
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # Can still access data after clearing
  data2 <- as.matrix(proxy)
  expect_equal(dim(data), dim(data2))
  expect_equal(data, data2)
})


test_that("Integration: All S3 methods work transparently", {
  spec <- model_spec(
    type = "classification", 
    data = trial_data,
    labels = event_model$conditions
  )
  
  model <- create_projected_model(spec, projection_matrix)
  
  proxy <- if (inherits(model$dataset, "ProjectedDataSource")) {
    model$dataset
  } else {
    model$dataset$data
  }
  
  # Test all S3 methods without triggering projection
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # These should work without projection
  expect_equal(dim(proxy), c(n_trials, 10))
  expect_equal(nrow(proxy), n_trials)
  expect_equal(ncol(proxy), 10)
  expect_equal(length(proxy), n_trials * 10)
  
  # Still not cached
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # These might trigger projection depending on implementation
  expect_length(rownames(proxy), n_trials)
  expect_length(colnames(proxy), 10)
  expect_true(is.matrix(proxy))
  expect_true(is.numeric(proxy))
  
  # Subsetting triggers projection
  sub <- proxy[1:5, 1:3]
  expect_equal(dim(sub), c(5, 3))
  expect_true(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # Other methods work on cached data
  expect_equal(nrow(head(proxy)), 6)
  expect_equal(nrow(tail(proxy)), 6)
  
  # Print and str methods
  expect_output(print(proxy), "ProjectedDataSource")
  expect_output(str(proxy), "ProjectedDataSource")
})

<file path="tests/testthat/test-ls-svd-hrf-recovery.R">
context("ls+svd HRF recovery")

test_that("LS+SVD recovers SPMG1 HRF using BSPLINE basis", {
  if (!requireNamespace("fmrireg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    skip("fmrireg not installed")
  }

  set.seed(123)
  sim <- fmrireg::simulate_bold_signal(ncond = 1,
                                       hrf = fmrireg::HRF_SPMG1,
                                       nreps = 40,
                                       isi = c(1, 3),
                                       TR = 1)

  time <- sim$mat[, 1]
  bold <- sim$mat[, 2]

  em <- list(onsets = as.integer(round(sim$onset)),
             n_time = length(time),
             basis_length = 30L)

  X_obj <- build_design_matrix(em,
                               hrf_basis_func = fmrireg::HRF_BSPLINE,
                               theta_params = list(df = 10),
                               sparse = FALSE)
  X <- X_obj$X

  proj <- build_projector(X, lambda_global = 0)
  beta_hat <- drop(proj$K_global %*% bold)
  nbasis <- ncol(X) / length(em$onsets)
  beta_mat <- matrix(beta_hat, ncol = nbasis, byrow = TRUE)

  sv <- svd(beta_mat)
  hrf_est <- sv$u[, 1]
  if (sum(hrf_est) < 0) hrf_est <- -hrf_est

  true_hrf <- fmrireg::HRF_SPMG1(seq_along(hrf_est) - 1)
  expect_gt(cor(hrf_est, true_hrf), 0.9)
})
</file>

<file path="tests/testthat/test-make-trialwise-X.R">
test_that("build_design_matrix constructs sparse matrix with basis matrix", {
  em <- list(onsets = c(0L, 2L), n_time = 6L)
  basis <- matrix(c(1, 0, 0,
                    0, 1, 0), nrow = 3, byrow = FALSE)
  res <- build_design_matrix(em, hrf_basis_matrix = basis)
  X <- res$X
  expect_s4_class(X, "dgCMatrix")
  expect_equal(dim(X), c(6L, 6L))
  dense <- as.matrix(X)
  expect_equal(dense[1,1], 1)
  expect_equal(dense[3,4], 1)
})

test_that("build_design_matrix uses hrf_basis_func and theta_params", {
  em <- list(onsets = c(1L), n_time = 5L, basis_length = 3L)
  hfun <- function(theta, t) {
    matrix(theta[1] + t, nrow = 3, ncol = 1)
  }
  res <- build_design_matrix(em, hrf_basis_func = hfun, theta_params = c(2))
  X <- res$X
  dense <- as.matrix(X)
  expect_equal(dense[2,1], 2)
  expect_equal(dense[3,1], 3)
})

test_that("parametric modulation scales columns", {
  em <- list(onsets = c(0L,2L), n_time = 6L,
             modulator = c(1,2))
  basis <- matrix(c(1,0), nrow = 2)
  res <- build_design_matrix(em, hrf_basis_matrix = basis)
  X <- as.matrix(res$X)
  expect_equal(X[1,1], 1)
  expect_equal(X[3,2], 2)
})

test_that("long HRF basis is decimated", {
  em <- list(onsets = c(0L), n_time = 4L, basis_length = 10L)
  basis_fun <- function(theta, t) matrix(1, nrow = length(t), ncol = 1)
  res <- build_design_matrix(em, hrf_basis_func = basis_fun)
  expect_equal(nrow(res$hrf_info$basis), 4L)
})

test_that("input lengths are validated", {
  basis <- matrix(1, nrow = 2, ncol = 1)

  em_amp <- list(onsets = c(0L, 2L), n_time = 6L,
                 amplitudes = c(1))
  expect_error(build_design_matrix(em_amp, hrf_basis_matrix = basis),
               "amplitudes")

  em_mod <- list(onsets = c(0L, 2L), n_time = 6L,
                 modulator = c(1))
  expect_error(build_design_matrix(em_mod, hrf_basis_matrix = basis),
               "modulator")
})

<file path="tests/testthat/test-model-factory.R">
context("Model factory with S3 dispatch")

# Mock rMVPA functions for testing
setup_rmvpa_mocks <- function() {
  if (!"mock_rMVPA" %in% search()) {
    mock_env <- new.env()
    
    # Mock model constructors
    mock_env$mvpa_model <- function(...) {
      args <- list(...)
      structure(args, class = c("mvpa_model", "list"))
    }
    
    mock_env$rsa_model <- function(...) {
      args <- list(...)
      structure(args, class = c("rsa_model", "mvpa_model", "list"))
    }
    
    mock_env$feature_rsa_model <- function(...) {
      args <- list(...)
      structure(args, class = c("feature_rsa_model", "mvpa_model", "list"))
    }
    
    mock_env$vector_rsa_model <- function(...) {
      args <- list(...)
      structure(args, class = c("vector_rsa_model", "mvpa_model", "list"))
    }
    
    mock_env$load_model <- function(name) {
      list(algorithm = name)
    }
    
    mock_env$mvpa_design <- function(...) {
      list(...)
    }
    
    attach(mock_env, name = "mock_rMVPA")
  }
}

teardown_rmvpa_mocks <- function() {
  if ("mock_rMVPA" %in% search()) {
    detach("mock_rMVPA")
  }
}

test_that("model_spec creates proper specifications", {
  # Classification spec
  spec1 <- model_spec(
    type = "classification",
    data = matrix(1:20, 10, 2),
    labels = rep(c("A", "B"), 5)
  )
  
  expect_s3_class(spec1, "classification")
  expect_s3_class(spec1, "model_spec")
  expect_equal(spec1$type, "classification")
  expect_equal(dim(spec1$data), c(10, 2))
  
  # RSA spec
  spec2 <- model_spec(
    type = "rsa",
    data = matrix(1:20, 10, 2),
    distance_method = "euclidean"
  )
  
  expect_s3_class(spec2, "rsa")
  expect_equal(spec2$distance_method, "euclidean")
})

test_that("create_projected_model dispatches correctly", {
  setup_rmvpa_mocks()
  on.exit(teardown_rmvpa_mocks())
  
  # Test data
  X <- matrix(rnorm(50), 10, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(10), 5, 2)
  
  # Classification model
  spec <- model_spec(
    type = "classification",
    data = X,
    labels = rep(c("A", "B"), 5),
    algorithm = "lda"
  )
  
  # Mock build_rmvpa_model temporarily
  orig_build <- build_rmvpa_model
  build_rmvpa_model <<- function(type, data, ...) {
    # Verify proxy was created
    expect_s3_class(data, "ProjectedDataSource")
    expect_equal(data$nrow, 10)
    expect_equal(data$ncol, 2)
    
    list(type = type, data_class = class(data)[1], ...)
  }
  
  result <- create_projected_model(spec, P)
  
  expect_equal(result$type, "classification")
  expect_equal(result$data_class, "ProjectedDataSource")
  
  # Restore
  build_rmvpa_model <<- orig_build
})

test_that("create_projected_model handles list specs", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(50), 10, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(10), 5, 2)
  
  # List without class
  spec <- list(
    type = "regression",
    data = X,
    response = rnorm(10)
  )
  
  # Should add class and dispatch
  expect_s3_class(
    create_projected_model.default(spec, P),
    "regression"
  )
})

test_that("create_projection_proxy handles different projection types", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(50), 10, 5)
  
  # Matrix projection
  P <- matrix(rnorm(10), 5, 2)
  proxy1 <- create_projection_proxy(X, P)
  expect_s3_class(proxy1, "ProjectedDataSource")
  expect_equal(proxy1$ncol, 2)
  
  # Function projection
  proj_fun <- function(data) data[, 1:2]
  proxy2 <- create_projection_proxy(X, proj_fun)
  expect_s3_class(proxy2, "ProjectedDataSource")
  
  # projection_spec projection
  proj_spec <- projection_spec(
    event_model = list(onsets = 1:10),
    projector_components = list(dummy = TRUE),
    N_trials = 10,
    K_hrf = 3,
    lambda_adaptive_method = "EB",
    lambda_global = 0.1,
    collapse_method = "rss"
  )
  
  # Mock the projection functions
  orig_arp <- adaptive_ridge_projector
  orig_cb <- collapse_beta
  
  adaptive_ridge_projector <<- function(...) {
    list(Z_sl_raw = matrix(rnorm(30), 10, 3))
  }
  
  collapse_beta <<- function(...) {
    list(A_sl = matrix(rnorm(20), 10, 2))
  }
  
  proxy3 <- create_projection_proxy(X, proj_spec)
  expect_s3_class(proxy3, "ProjectedDataSource")
  
  # Restore
  adaptive_ridge_projector <<- orig_arp
  collapse_beta <<- orig_cb
})

test_that("S3 dispatch works for all model types", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(50), 10, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(10), 5, 2)
  
  # Test each model type has a method
  model_types <- c("classification", "regression", "rsa", 
                   "feature_rsa", "vector_rsa", "contrast_rsa")
  
  for (type in model_types) {
    spec <- structure(list(type = type, data = X), class = c(type, "list"))
    
    # Check method exists
    method_name <- paste0("create_projected_model.", type)
    expect_true(
      exists(method_name),
      info = paste("Method", method_name, "should exist")
    )
  }
})

test_that("extract_model_metadata works correctly", {
  # With metadata
  spec1 <- list(
    feature_names = c("F1", "F2", "F3"),
    attributes = list(version = 1),
    design = "test_design"
  )
  
  meta1 <- extract_model_metadata(spec1)
  expect_equal(meta1$feature_names, c("F1", "F2", "F3"))
  expect_equal(meta1$attributes$version, 1)
  
  # Without metadata
  meta2 <- extract_model_metadata(NULL)
  expect_null(meta2)
  
  # Empty spec
  meta3 <- extract_model_metadata(list())
  expect_equal(names(meta3), c("feature_names", "attributes", "design"))
  expect_null(meta3$feature_names)
})

test_that("create_mvpa_model_projected provides convenience wrapper", {
  setup_rmvpa_mocks()
  on.exit(teardown_rmvpa_mocks())
  
  X <- matrix(rnorm(50), 10, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(10), 5, 2)
  
  # Mock functions
  orig_cpm <- create_projected_model
  orig_brm <- build_rmvpa_model
  
  create_projected_model <<- function(spec, projection) {
    list(created_with = "projection", spec = spec, projection = projection)
  }
  
  build_rmvpa_model <<- function(...) {
    list(created_with = "no_projection", ...)
  }
  
  # With projection
  result1 <- create_mvpa_model_projected(
    "classification",
    dataset = X,
    projection = P,
    labels = rep(c("A", "B"), 5)
  )
  
  expect_equal(result1$created_with, "projection")
  
  # Without projection
  result2 <- create_mvpa_model_projected(
    "classification",
    dataset = X,
    labels = rep(c("A", "B"), 5)
  )
  
  expect_equal(result2$created_with, "no_projection")
  
  # Restore
  create_projected_model <<- orig_cpm
  build_rmvpa_model <<- orig_brm
})

<file path="tests/testthat/test-optimize-joint-hrf.R">
context("optimize_hrf_mvpa")

test_that("optimize_hrf_mvpa basic flow", {
  Y <- matrix(1, nrow = 6, ncol = 2)
  em <- list(onsets = c(0L, 2L), n_time = 6L, basis_length = 2L)
  basis_fun <- function(theta, t) {
    matrix(theta[1], nrow = length(t), ncol = 1)
  }
  inner_fn <- function(A) {
    sum(A)
  }
  res <- optimize_hrf_mvpa(theta_init = c(1),
                                 Y = Y,
                                 event_model = em,
                                 inner_cv_fn = inner_fn,
                                 hrf_basis_func = basis_fun,
                                 lambda_global = 0,
                                 diagnostics = TRUE,
                                 optim_method = "Nelder-Mead")
  expect_true(is.numeric(res$theta_hat))
  expect_true(!is.null(res$diagnostics$theta_trace))
  expect_true(nrow(res$diagnostics$theta_trace) >= 1)
})



test_that("finite differences run regardless of TMB", {


  Y <- matrix(1, nrow = 2, ncol = 1)
  em <- list(onsets = c(0L), n_time = 2L, basis_length = 1L)
  basis_fun <- function(theta, t) {
    matrix(theta[1], nrow = length(t), ncol = 1)
  }

  res <- optimize_hrf_mvpa(theta_init = c(1),
                           Y = Y,
                           event_model = em,
                           inner_cv_fn = sum,
                           hrf_basis_func = basis_fun,
                           use_fd_grad = TRUE,
                           optim_method = "Nelder-Mead")
  expect_true(is.numeric(res$theta_hat))


  expect_silent(
    optimize_hrf_mvpa(
      theta_init = c(1),
      Y = Y,
      event_model = em,
      inner_cv_fn = sum,
      hrf_basis_func = basis_fun,
      use_fd_grad = TRUE,
      optim_method = "Nelder-Mead"
    )

  expect_warning(
    optimize_hrf_mvpa(theta_init = c(1),
                       Y = Y,
                       event_model = em,
                       inner_cv_fn = sum,
                       hrf_basis_func = basis_fun,
                       use_fd_grad = TRUE,
                       optim_method = "Nelder-Mead"),
    "gradients set to NULL"
  )

})

<file path="tests/testthat/test-projected-data-source.R">
context("ProjectedDataSource proxy object")

test_that("ProjectedDataSource creates valid proxy", {
  # Test data
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  # Create proxy
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  expect_equal(proxy$nrow, 20)
  expect_equal(proxy$ncol, 3)
  expect_equal(proxy$dim, c(20, 3))
})

test_that("ProjectedDataSource performs lazy projection", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  # Should not be cached initially
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # Access triggers projection
  result <- proxy$as.matrix()
  
  expect_equal(dim(result), c(20, 3))
  expect_true(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # Second access uses cache
  result2 <- proxy$as.matrix()
  expect_identical(result, result2)
})

test_that("ProjectedDataSource preserves metadata", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  rownames(X) <- paste0("Sample", 1:20)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  metadata <- list(
    feature_names = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"),
    attributes = list(
      study = "test_study",
      version = 1.0
    )
  )
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P, metadata)
  result <- proxy$as.matrix()
  
  expect_equal(rownames(result), paste0("Sample", 1:20))
  expect_equal(colnames(result), c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"))
  expect_equal(attr(result, "study"), "test_study")
  expect_equal(attr(result, "version"), 1.0)
})

test_that("ProjectedDataSource supports function-based projection", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  
  # PCA projection function
  proj_fun <- function(data) {
    # Don't scale if only testing with one row
    if (nrow(data) == 1) {
      # Simple projection for single row test
      data[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      pc <- prcomp(data, scale. = TRUE)
      pc$x[, 1:2]
    }
  }
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, proj_fun)
  
  expect_equal(proxy$nrow, 20)
  expect_equal(proxy$ncol, 2)
  
  result <- proxy$as.matrix()
  expect_equal(dim(result), c(20, 2))
})

test_that("ProjectedDataSource supports subsetting", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  # Row subsetting
  sub1 <- proxy[1:5, ]
  expect_equal(dim(sub1), c(5, 3))
  
  # Column subsetting
  sub2 <- proxy[, 1:2]
  expect_equal(dim(sub2), c(20, 2))
  
  # Both
  sub3 <- proxy[1:5, 1:2]
  expect_equal(dim(sub3), c(5, 2))
})

test_that("ProjectedDataSource get_rows provides chunked access", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(1000), 200, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  # Get specific rows without caching full matrix
  chunk <- proxy$get_rows(1:10)
  
  expect_equal(dim(chunk), c(10, 3))
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())  # Should not cache full matrix
})

test_that("as.matrix S3 method works", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  # S3 method
  result <- as.matrix(proxy)
  
  expect_equal(dim(result), c(20, 3))
  expect_equal(as.numeric(result), as.numeric(X %*% P))
})

test_that("ProjectedDataSource handles sparse matrices", {
  skip_if_not_installed("Matrix")
  
  # Create sparse matrix
  X <- Matrix::rsparsematrix(20, 5, density = 0.3)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  result <- proxy$as.matrix()
  
  expect_equal(dim(result), c(20, 3))
  expect_true(is.matrix(result))  # Result should be dense
})

test_that("ProjectedDataSource validates inputs", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(12), 4, 3)  # Wrong dimensions
  
  expect_error(
    ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P),
    "data columns .* must match projection rows"
  )
  
  expect_error(
    ProjectedDataSource$new("not a matrix", P),
    "data must be a matrix"
  )
  
  expect_error(
    ProjectedDataSource$new(X, "not a projection"),
    "projection must be a matrix or function"
  )
})

test_that("ProjectedDataSource active bindings work", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  # data binding triggers projection
  result <- proxy$data
  expect_equal(dim(result), c(20, 3))
  expect_true(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # original_data binding
  orig <- proxy$original_data
  expect_identical(orig, X)
  
  # projection_matrix binding
  proj <- proxy$projection_matrix
  expect_identical(proj, P)
})

test_that("clear_cache works", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  # Cache data
  result1 <- proxy$as.matrix()
  expect_true(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # Clear cache
  proxy$clear_cache()
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())
  
  # Re-access creates new projection
  result2 <- proxy$as.matrix()
  expect_equal(result1, result2)  # Results should be identical
  expect_true(proxy$is_cached())
})

test_that("transpose works correctly", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(100), 20, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  # Transpose
  result_t <- t(proxy)
  
  # Should match manual transpose
  expected <- t(X %*% P)
  expect_equal(as.numeric(result_t), as.numeric(expected))
  expect_equal(dim(result_t), c(3, 20))
})

test_that("optimized row subsetting avoids full projection", {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(1000), 200, 5)
  P <- matrix(rnorm(15), 5, 3)
  
  proxy <- ProjectedDataSource$new(X, P)
  
  # Row-only subsetting should not cache full matrix
  rows <- proxy[1:10, ]
  expect_false(proxy$is_cached())
  expect_equal(dim(rows), c(10, 3))
  
  # Column subsetting requires full projection
  cols <- proxy[, 1:2]
  expect_true(proxy$is_cached())
  expect_equal(dim(cols), c(200, 2))
})
</file>

test_that("make_spmat_triplet creates expected sparse matrix", {
  i <- c(0L, 1L)
  j <- c(0L, 1L)
  x <- c(1, 2)
  sm <- make_spmat_triplet(i, j, x, 2L, 2L)
  expect_s4_class(sm, "dgCMatrix")
  expect_equal(as.matrix(sm), matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 2), 2, 2))
})

  j <- c(0L, 1L)
  x <- c(1, 2)
  sm <- make_spmat_triplet(i, j, x, 2L, 2L)
  dense <- matrix(1, 2, 2)
  res <- spmat_dense_prod(sm, dense)
  expect_equal(res, as.matrix(sm %*% dense))

  expect_error(make_spmat_triplet(c(0L, NA), c(0L, 1L), c(1, 2), 2L, 2L),
               "must not contain NA")
  expect_error(make_spmat_triplet(c(-1L, 0L), c(0L, 1L), c(1, 2), 2L, 2L),
               "non-negative")
  expect_error(make_spmat_triplet(c(0L, 1L), c(0L, 2L), c(1, 2), 2L, 2L),
               "out of range")
})

test_that("spmat_dense_prod validates inputs", {
  sm <- make_spmat_triplet(0L, 0L, 1, 2L, 2L)
  expect_error(spmat_dense_prod(as.matrix(sm), matrix(1, 2, 2)), "dgCMatrix")
  expect_error(spmat_dense_prod(sm, 1), "matrix")
  expect_error(spmat_dense_prod(sm, matrix(1, 3, 2)), "Non-conformable")
})

<file path="tests/testthat/test-refactor-verification.R">
# Verification test for Qt refactoring
# This test ensures the new qr_obj implementation is numerically equivalent to the legacy Qt approach

context("Refactoring verification - Qt to qr_obj")

test_that("New qr_obj approach produces identical results to legacy Qt approach", {
  set.seed(123)
  
  # Create test data
  n_time <- 50
  n_trials <- 10
  n_basis <- 3
  n_voxels <- 5
  
  # Build design matrix
  X <- Matrix::rsparsematrix(n_time, n_trials * n_basis, density = 0.3)
  
  # Test data for projection
  Y <- matrix(rnorm(n_time * n_voxels), n_time, n_voxels)
  
  # Build projectors with both approaches
  proj_new <- build_projector(X, lambda_global = 0.1)
  proj_legacy <- build_projector(X, lambda_global = 0.1, legacy_output = TRUE)
  
  # Test adaptive_ridge_projector with both
  res_new <- adaptive_ridge_projector(
    Y_sl = Y,
    projector_components = proj_new,
    lambda_adaptive_method = "none",
    lambda_floor_global = 0.1
  )
  
  res_legacy <- adaptive_ridge_projector(
    Y_sl = Y,
    projector_components = proj_legacy,
    lambda_adaptive_method = "none",
    lambda_floor_global = 0.1
  )
  
  # Results should be numerically identical
  expect_equal(
    as.numeric(res_new$Z_sl_raw), 
    as.numeric(res_legacy$Z_sl_raw),
    tolerance = 1e-12
  )
})

test_that("Memory usage: new approach doesn't create Qt matrix", {
  set.seed(456)
  
  # Create a larger test case
  X <- Matrix::rsparsematrix(100, 30, density = 0.3)
  
  # New approach should not have Qt
  proj_new <- build_projector(X, lambda_global = 0.5)
  expect_null(proj_new$Qt)
  expect_null(proj_new$tRQt)
  expect_null(proj_new$K_global)
  expect_true(!is.null(proj_new$qr_obj))
  expect_equal(proj_new$.internal_representation, "qr")
  
  # Legacy approach should have Qt
  proj_legacy <- build_projector(X, lambda_global = 0.5, legacy_output = TRUE)
  expect_true(!is.null(proj_legacy$Qt))
  expect_true(!is.null(proj_legacy$tRQt))
  expect_true(!is.null(proj_legacy$K_global))
  expect_null(proj_legacy$qr_obj)
  expect_equal(proj_legacy$.internal_representation, "explicit")
})

test_that("qr.qty produces same result as Qt %*% Y", {
  set.seed(789)
  
  # Small example for direct comparison
  X <- Matrix::rsparsematrix(20, 6, density = 0.5)
  Y <- matrix(rnorm(20 * 3), 20, 3)
  
  # Get QR decomposition
  qr_obj <- Matrix::qr(X)
  Qt <- t(as.matrix(Matrix::qr.Q(qr_obj)))
  
  # Compare Qt %*% Y with qr.qty
  result_explicit <- Qt %*% Y
  result_qty <- Matrix::qr.qty(qr_obj, Y)
  
  # They should be identical (qr.qty returns full length, we need first p rows)
  p <- ncol(X)
  expect_equal(
    as.matrix(result_explicit),
    as.matrix(result_qty[1:p, , drop = FALSE]),
    tolerance = 1e-12
  )
})
</file>
